sources.title: Collected writings of Jose Marti (essays, poetry, correspondence)

risk_tolerance.rationale: Arrested and sentenced to hard labor at age 16-17 for a letter accusing a classmate of treason to the Cuban independence cause, and ultimately died in his first battle at Dos Rios in 1895 after returning to Cuba to fight despite being primarily known as a writer/organizer rather than a soldier -- both specific, precisely documented, extreme instances of sustained personal risk across his entire life.

leadership_drive.rationale: Founded the Cuban Revolutionary Party in New York in 1892 specifically to organize Cuban independence, and was elected its delegate -- a specific, dated, extensively documented organizational leadership role.

proactive_agency.rationale: Independently organized and mobilized Cuban exile communities in Tampa and Key West, and personally planned an armed expedition to Cuba (the ships were seized by US authorities before departure) -- specific, documented, self-initiated organizing acts.

persistence.rationale: Sustaining organizing, writing, and fundraising for Cuban independence across roughly 15 years of exile (1880-1895) implies real persistence, inferred from the documented duration of his organizing career.

creative_originality.rationale: Recognized as a foundational figure of Spanish American literary modernism, having produced a substantial body of poetry and essays across multiple genres, inferred from the documented scholarly regard for his literary innovation.

social_assertiveness.rationale: Sustained direct organizing among Cuban cigar-factory workers in Tampa and Key West implies strong social assertiveness, inferred from the documented organizing pattern.

cross_domain_range.rationale: Sustained output as poet, essayist, journalist, and political organizer simultaneously across his adult life implies real range across domains, inferred from the documented breadth of his activity.

persuasiveness.rationale: Successfully raising funds and organizing among Cuban exile communities across multiple US cities implies real persuasive capability, inferred from the documented outcomes of that organizing.

achievement_drive.rationale: Sustaining a singular overarching goal (Cuban independence) across 15 years of exile and ultimately his own death implies strong achievement drive, inferred from the documented career arc.

curiosity.rationale: A law degree combined with sustained literary and journalistic output across multiple genres suggests broad intellectual curiosity, inferred from the documented range of his education and output.

discipline.rationale: Sustaining organizing and writing output across 15 years of exile implies real behavioral discipline, inferred from the documented duration of the effort.

planning_orientation.rationale: Organizing a specific armed expedition (the seized ships) implies real logistical planning capability, inferred from the documented existence and scale of that planning effort.

impact_motivation.rationale: A sustained, singular life orientation toward Cuban independence, expressed across poetry, journalism, and direct organizing, and ultimately his own death in pursuit of it, implies exceptionally strong impact motivation, inferred from the documented consistency of his life's work.

analytical_rigor.rationale: His essays on US politics and Latin American identity (e.g. 'Nuestra America') are documented as substantive political analysis still studied academically, inferred as evidence of real analytical capability from their sustained scholarly regard.

detail_orientation.rationale: Organizing a specific armed expedition with defined logistics (the seized ships) implies real attention to operational detail, inferred from the documented existence of that planning.

collaboration.rationale: Founding and sustaining the Cuban Revolutionary Party as a coalition of diverse exile factions implies real collaborative capacity, inferred from the documented breadth of the coalition he built.

adaptability.rationale: Sustaining organizing work across multiple countries and communities (Cuba, Spain, Mexico, Guatemala, Venezuela, the US) over his adult life implies real adaptability, inferred from the documented breadth of these contexts.

opportunity_sensing.rationale: Recognizing the specific political moment (weakening Spanish colonial control, growing exile-community organization) to found the Cuban Revolutionary Party in 1892 suggests real opportunity recognition, inferred from the documented timing of the founding.
